'''Making a Bridge''' is a weave of the [[One Power]]; it is formed by a combination of threads of Air with an intricate lace of Fire; after the formation of the bridge, it can carry any amount of weight. It was formed by [[Rand]] over the [[river Alguenya]] between the boat where he was and a boat of the [[Sea Folk]].{{ref|{{acos|34}}}}

For some reason, despite Rand's strength he can only make a bridge about twenty [[measurement|pace]]s long; any longer and it would "fall apart at the first step". He also notes that a woman could use ''[[saidar]]'' to make a longer bridge, even if she did not have as much [[Strength in the One Power rankings|strength]].
